sentences.text: Tinkers Farm
Rabley Stephen
It is 7 o'clock on a warm summer morning.
sentences.translation: إنها الساعة السابعة في صباح صيفي دافئ.

sentences.text: A ship is arriving in New York.
Its name is the Red Rose.
Two of the people on it are Sam Tinker and his daughter Jenny.
sentences.translation: اثنان من الأشخاص عليها هما سام تينكر وابنته جيني.

sentences.text: Sam and Jenny are English, but now they are starting a new life in America.
sentences.translation: سام وجيني إنجليزيان، لكنهما الآن يبدآن حياة جديدة في أمريكا.

sentences.text: "Look, Dad!" says Jenny.
"We're here. We're really here!"
The Tinkers say goodbye to all their friends.
Then they leave the Red Rose.
There are lots of people, horses and carts beside the ship.
sentences.translation: هناك الكثير من الناس والخيول والعربات بجانب السفينة.

sentences.text: Sam looks at them.
"Yes, we're here," he thinks.
"But now what? We haven't got any money."
sentences.translation: "لكن ماذا الآن؟ ليس لدينا أي مال."

sentences.text: He stops a young man with a green coat.
"Excuse me," he says.
"I'm looking for a job."
The man turns to his right.
"Talk to Jack Crane," he answers.
Jack Crane is a farmer.
He has a long, thin face and only three fingers on his right hand.
sentences.translation: لديه وجه طويل ونحيف وثلاثة أصابع فقط في يده اليمنى.

sentences.text: He listens to Sam's story.
Then he takes off his hat.
"OK," he says, "you can both have jobs."
"I need a new man to work in the fields."
"And we want someone to help in the kitchen, too - isn't that right, Blue Sky?"
sentences.translation: "ونريد شخصاً للمساعدة في المطبخ أيضاً - أليس كذلك يا بلو سكاي؟"

sentences.text: There is an Indian girl on top of the cart.
sentences.translation: هناك فتاة هندية على قمة العربة.

sentences.text: "Yes," she says and smiles at Jenny.
Two hours later the Tinkers leave New York with Jack Crane and Blue Sky.
sentences.translation: بعد ساعتين، يغادر آل تينكر نيويورك مع جاك كرين وبلو سكاي.

sentences.text: They are both very happy.
"How far is it to your farm, Mr Crane?" asks Sam.
sentences.translation: "كم تبعد مزرعتك يا سيد كرين؟" يسأل سام.

sentences.text: "Eighty kilometres," Jack Crane answers.
They drive all afternoon.
Jenny is sitting next to Sam.
She is tired, but she does not want to sleep.
sentences.translation: إنها متعبة، لكنها لا تريد النوم.

sentences.text: "This is America," she thinks,"... and now I'm American."
After six hours Jack Crane stops the cart.
sentences.translation: بعد ست ساعات، يوقف جاك كرين العربة.

sentences.text: "Well... there it is," he says.
Jenny stands up.
It is evening now and the sun is going down.
In front of them there are lots of beautiful yellow fields and a big farmhouse.
sentences.translation: أمامهم توجد حقول صفراء جميلة كثيرة ومزرعة كبيرة.

sentences.text: Jenny looks to her left.
"Where's that smoke coming from?" she asks.
"That's the Indian village," answers Blue Sky.
sentences.translation: "تلك هي القرية الهندية،" تجيب بلو سكاي.

sentences.text: "My family lives there."
The next day the Tinkers start work.
sentences.translation: في اليوم التالي يبدأ آل تينكر العمل.

sentences.text: Jenny helps Blue Sky in the farmhouse.
sentences.translation: تساعد جيني بلو سكاي في المزرعة.

sentences.text: First the two girls cook everyone's breakfast.
Then they make all the beds.
After that they clean the kitchen floor.
At the same time Sam is working in the fields.
sentences.translation: في نفس الوقت، يعمل سام في الحقول.

sentences.text: After four or five hours he stops for a minute.
sentences.translation: بعد أربع أو خمس ساعات يتوقف لدقيقة.

sentences.text: "What are you stopping for?" asks Jack Crane.
"Come on - get back to work!"
Sam and Jenny have only one free day every week - Sunday.
sentences.translation: لدى سام وجيني يوم راحة واحد فقط كل أسبوع - الأحد.

sentences.text: It's Blue Sky's free day, too.
sentences.translation: إنه يوم راحة بلو سكاي أيضاً.

sentences.text: That is when she visits her family.
One Sunday Jenny goes with her.
sentences.translation: في أحد أيام الأحد، تذهب جيني معها.

sentences.text: She makes a lot of new friends.
She meets the village Chief, too - Silver Cloud.
sentences.translation: تلتقي أيضاً بزعيم القرية - سيلفر كلاود.

sentences.text: He has a beautiful wife and a young son.
After that first visit, Jenny often goes to the village.
sentences.translation: بعد تلك الزيارة الأولى، تذهب جيني غالباً إلى القرية.

sentences.text: She starts to learn some Indian words, too.
sentences.translation: تبدأ في تعلم بعض الكلمات الهندية أيضاً.

sentences.text: Jenny is always happy with her new Indian friends.
sentences.translation: جيني سعيدة دائماً مع أصدقائها الهنود الجدد.

sentences.text: But she is not happy on the farm.
Sam is unhappy, too.
"I don't want to work here on Jack Crane's farm any more," he says one evening.
sentences.translation: "لا أريد العمل هنا في مزرعة جاك كرين بعد الآن،" يقول ذات مساء.

sentences.text: "I want to work on my farm, Tinkers Farm."
"I know, Dad," Jenny answers.
Then she thinks, "But how? We can't buy any land."
sentences.translation: ثم تفكر: "لكن كيف؟ لا يمكننا شراء أي أرض."

sentences.text: Jack Crane pays us only two dollars a week.
sentences.translation: جاك كرين يدفع لنا دولارين فقط في الأسبوع.

sentences.text: Four days later Jenny and Blue Sky are making the beds.
sentences.translation: بعد أربعة أيام، كانت جيني وبلو سكاي ترتبان الأسرّة.

sentences.text: Suddenly they hear something.
Two men are shouting.
Jenny looks out of the window.
She can see Jack Crane and her father in front of the farmhouse.
sentences.translation: يمكنها رؤية جاك كرين ووالدها أمام المزرعة.

sentences.text: Jack Crane's face is very red.
"Do it!" he shouts.
"No, I'm not going to," Sam shouts back.
sentences.translation: "لا، لن أفعل،" يصرخ سام رداً عليه.

sentences.text: "It's Sunday and I don't work on Sundays. You do it!"
sentences.translation: "إنه يوم الأحد ولا أعمل أيام الآحاد. افعلها أنت!"

sentences.text: Jenny runs downstairs and out of the house.
sentences.translation: تركض جيني إلى الطابق السفلي وتخرج من المنزل.

sentences.text: There is a strong wind and it is raining.
"What's happening?" she asks her father.
"We're leaving in the morning," Sam answers.
He is walking very fast.
Jenny looks at him.
"But... how are we going to eat? We haven't got any money."
sentences.translation: "لكن... كيف سنأكل؟ ليس لدينا أي مال."

sentences.text: Sam does not answer.
His eyes are cold and hard.
That evening Jenny and Blue Sky go to the Indian village.
sentences.translation: في ذلك المساء، تذهب جيني وبلو سكاي إلى القرية الهندية.

sentences.text: "This is going to be my last visit." Jenny thinks.
Blue Sky is sad, too.
She does not want to lose her friend.
sentences.translation: إنها لا تريد أن تفقد صديقتها.

sentences.text: The two girls say nothing for twenty minutes.
sentences.translation: الفتاتان لا تقولان شيئاً لمدة عشرين دقيقة.

sentences.text: Then Blue Sky stops her horse.
She can see something in the river to their right.
sentences.translation: يمكنها رؤية شيء ما في النهر على يمينهما.

sentences.text: It is a small boy.
"Help!" he is shouting.
"I can't swim. Help me! Please!"
"It's the Chief's son!" says Blue Sky.
"What are we going to..." But before she can say another word, Jenny gets off her horse.
sentences.translation: "ماذا سنفعل..." لكن قبل أن تقول كلمة أخرى، تنزل جيني من حصانها.

sentences.text: "I'm coming," she shouts.
Then she jumps into the cold river.
"Help!" shouts the boy.
Jenny swims to him.
His head is going under the water.
She puts one arm around him.
"It's OK," she says.
"You're safe now."
Half an hour later Jenny and Blue Sky arrive at the Indian village.
sentences.translation: بعد نصف ساعة، تصل جيني وبلو سكاي إلى القرية الهندية.

sentences.text: The Chief comes to meet them.
"But... I don't understand," he says to Blue Sky.
sentences.translation: "لكن... أنا لا أفهم،" يقول لبلو سكاي.

sentences.text: "Why is my son with you? And why are he and the English girl wet?!"
sentences.translation: "لماذا ابني معك؟ ولماذا هو والفتاة الإنجليزية مبتلان؟!"

sentences.text: Blue Sky tells him the story.
After that the Chief is very happy.
sentences.translation: بعد ذلك، يصبح الزعيم سعيداً جداً.

sentences.text: He smiles at Jenny.
"How can I thank you?" he says.
"Please... let me give you something. Anything"
sentences.translation: "من فضلك... دعيني أعطيك شيئاً. أي شيء"

sentences.text: At 9 o'clock Sam is putting some boots into a bag.
sentences.translation: في الساعة التاسعة، كان سام يضع بعض الأحذية في حقيبة.

sentences.text: "What's going to happen tomorrow?" he thinks.
Suddenly the door opens.
It is Jenny.
"Come with me, Dad," she says.
"I want to show you something."
Sam looks at his daughter.
Her eyes are bright and she is smiling.
"What are you talking about?" he asks.
"There isn't time for any questions," says Jenny.
sentences.translation: "لا يوجد وقت لأي أسئلة،" تقول جيني.

sentences.text: "Come on."
She takes her father to a hill.
At the top she says, "Look! Can you see that land over there?"
sentences.translation: في القمة تقول: "انظر! هل ترى تلك الأرض هناك؟"

sentences.text: "Yes," Sam answers.
Then Jenny tells him about Silver Cloud's son.
sentences.translation: ثم تخبره جيني عن ابن سيلفر كلاود.

sentences.text: After she finishes, Sam says, "You mean...?"
sentences.translation: بعد أن تنتهي، يقول سام: "هل تقصدين...؟"

sentences.text: "Yes," Jenny smiles at her father.
"The Indians are giving us our own farm... 'TINKERS FARM'."
"Oh Dad, isn't it wonderful? Now we can really start a new life."
sentences.translation: "أوه أبي، أليس هذا رائعاً؟ الآن يمكننا حقاً بدء حياة جديدة."

sentences.text: - THE END -
Hope you have enjoyed the reading!
sentences.translation: أتمنى أن تكون قد استمتعت بالقراءة!

sentences.translation: عد إلى https://english-e-reader.net/ للعثور على المزيد من القصص الرائعة والمثيرة!
